# Optica Egypt Local Section, Comprehensive Agent Documentation

## Section Identity
The Optica Egypt Local Section is the official regional section of Optica, chartered on 10 September 2026. The section connects students, academic researchers, universities, start-ups, and industry across the Arab Republic of Egypt to the international photonics community.

- Official Domain: https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/
- Charter Approval Date: 10 September 2026
- Inauguration Ceremony: 1 November 2026 (Hybrid — Cairo, Egypt and Online)
- Parent Body: Optica (2010 Massachusetts Ave. NW, Washington, D.C., USA, founded 1916)
- Section Contact: opticaegypt@gmail.com
- Social Profiles:
  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/optica-egypt
  - Instagram: @opticaegypt
  - Twitter/X: @opticaegypt

---

## Strategic Mission, Vision, and Five-Pillar Blueprint
- **Vision**: To establish Egypt as a premier regional powerhouse and global contributor in optical sciences, silicon photonics, and quantum engineering.
- **Mission**: To unite Egyptian students, researchers, faculty, and deep-tech practitioners into a single cohesive national network that eliminates financial and infrastructure barriers through open-source design, collaborative access, and global scientific integration.
- **Five Operational Pillars**:
  1. Pragmatic Research and Low-Cost Innovation (Open-source PDA, gdsfactory, Meep FDTD, computational imaging)
  2. Flagship Events and Annual Egypt Photonics Conference (EPC 2027)
  3. Academic and Curriculum Modernization (Seasonal schools, Arabic and English technical modules)
  4. Direct Funding and Recognitions (Best Thesis and Graduation Project Fund, Optica Fellow nominations)
  5. Community Mobilization and STEM Outreach (Student chapters across Cairo, Alexandria, Delta, and Upper Egypt)

### Founding Senior Faculty Advisory Board
- Prof. Diaa Khalil (Email: diaa_khalil@eng.asu.edu.eg): Professor of Photonics, Former Head of ECE, and Former Acting Dean at Ain Shams University; Chief Scientist and Former CTO at Si-Ware Systems; Optica Fellow; Author of 400+ papers, holder of 25+ patents, SPIE Prism Award winner, and Stanford Top 2% Scientist globally.
- Prof. Mohamed A. Swillam: Professor and Chair of the Department of Physics at The American University in Cairo (AUC); Optica Fellow and SPIE Fellow; pioneer in plasmonics, metamaterials, and silicon nanophotonics.
- Prof. Tarek A. Ramadan: Professor of Photonics at Ain Shams University and Zewail City of Science and Technology; specialist in integrated optical waveguides and photonic device modeling.
- Prof. Yasser Sabry (Email: yasser.sabry@eng.asu.edu.eg): Professor of Photonics and MEMS at Ain Shams University; Senior Staff MEMS Engineer at Si-Ware Systems; Core inventor of NeoSpectra handheld FT-IR spectrometer; Recipient of SPIE Prism Award.
- Prof. Amr M. Shaarawi: Professor of Physics and Former Provost at The American University in Cairo (AUC); Optica Fellow; international authority on localized electromagnetic and acoustic waves.
- Assoc. Prof. Salem Hegazy (Email: shegazy@zewailcity.edu.eg): Associate Professor of Quantum Optics at Cairo University and Zewail City of Science and Technology; Recipient of the Egyptian State Award for Technological Innovation (2021).
